name: AutoBot
description: Detects when you enter a level and finds a route through it on its own

enabled.name: Enable bot
enabled.description: When on, the bot takes control as soon as you enter a level.

speed.name: Search speed
speed.description: Game speed while the bot is searching for a route (1 = normal). The final run is always at normal speed.

use-practice.name: Search in practice mode
use-practice.description: Uses practice checkpoints so every new try starts close to the obstacle. Much faster.

safe-mode.name: Safe mode
safe-mode.description: Bot runs do not save progress, stars or leaderboard results.

lookback.name: Lookback (ticks)
lookback.description: How far before a death (in 1/240 s ticks) the bot tries new inputs.

stride.name: Timing step (ticks)
stride.description: Step between tried input timings. 1 is the most precise and the slowest.

show-status.name: Show status
show-status.description: Shows the bot status in the top-left corner of the level.
